rationale: Prior to Aug 14/15, deadliest 2026 Indonesian quake was June 16 M6.7 Sigi quake in Central Sulawesi (3 deaths). At 21:58 UTC Aug 14 (05:58 AM Aug 15 local, matching ResCSV=2026-08-15), a shallow 10km M7.7 earthquake struck 68km NNW of Ende, Flores in East Nusa Tenggara (56k felt severe shaking, tsunami warning).
